svg.title: Boundary-State DETR with selective boundary transport
svg.desc: A single COCO photograph enters the backbone and encoder. In the last decoder layer, two opposed Mamba scans accumulate in-box content and carry exterior state across a candidate interval. The cells inside the interval set its transmission. A shared query gate admits the transmitted state. After averaging directions and weighting candidate states by their boundary probabilities, the decoder projects the result into a residual query update.

g.text: Inside the box, the numbers show illustrative cell retentions.
Each cell’s features set its Mamba retention (one channel shown).
